title: Ferdinand of Bavaria, Elector of Cologne, to Duke Maximilian I of Bavaria, Bonn, 22 December 1619

steps.what: DECODE record page and the eleven images, already in the untracked kaa4591/img/ work folder from the catalogue-161 session

agent sweep of Briefe und Akten zur Geschichte des Dreissigjaehrigen Krieges NF I/1 (Franz 1966), Hurter viii, Wolf/Breyer iv, Pastor, Google Books and archive.org for a printed text or decipherment of either 1619 letter
ten pages read line by line into transcription.txt, clear passages bracketed; pages 3-10 photographed upside down and rotated first
symbol inventory: 34 even two-digit values carry the letters, three-digit and odd two-digit groups stand apart, two signs recur at every word end
homophonic substitution with vowel homophones and a separate nomenclator, German plaintext
six annealing restarts over pages 1-3 (932 letters) against lang de-1500s
ten restarts over all ten pages (2482 letters); the key table settled and the text read as German
decode.py flagged every word the model dislikes; about sixty single-token transcription slips corrected (digit pairs 0/6, 3/5, 1/4, 2/7, 5/8), a sample re-checked on the images at full zoom
the key applied unchanged to the sibling record R9425 (ff. 278-280, same correspondence): its first cipher line reads 'lbrecht von Gottes Gnaden'
KAA 4591's own key records searched for the 1619 cipher: R9419 (f. 267) is a Latin 1-99 nomenclator, R9420-R9423 are 1530s-1583 alphabets
R9425's red marginal notes enhanced by channel separation and contrast, hoping for a group-by-group decipherment of the nomenclator; the margin is an abstract of the letter, not a decipherment

sender, recipient, place and date established from the clear last page ('meiner Statt Bonn den 22. Decembris Anno 1619', signed Ferdinand) and from the ciphered 'mein Thumbcapitel', 'meine Landtstendt', Paderborn

outcome.fraction_read_source: count.py over transcription.txt: enciphered tokens; letters in words that do not read as German counted unread, nomenclator groups without an established value counted unread
outcome.notes: Letters: 2483 of 2519 read. Nomenclator: only 248 = 'und' is established, from its own contexts. Four words (37 tokens) still do not read and three read as proper names whose bearers are not identified.

prior.where: DECODE R9426 'Non-decrypted'; not in Briefe und Akten NF I/1 (Franz 1966), Hurter viii, Wolf/Breyer iv or Pastor; 'Kurbayern Aeusseres Archiv 4591' cited nowhere

human: supplied the DECODE account whose cookie fetched the images in an earlier session; nothing else
